title: Act 1 - Segment 3: Vermilion City to Route 2 (Thunder Badge)
synopsis: Board the luxury cruise liner S.S. Anne in Vermilion Harbor to battle your Rival and obtain HM01 Cut from the Captain. Trek through Diglett's Cave to Route 2 to claim the Shears tool, solve the Vermilion Gym puzzle, and defeat Lt. Surge in a 3v3 electric clash under the Level 29 cap.
